Agent-facing documents 60.5% of documentation interactions (instruction files 35.4%, working notes 25.1%; 55.1% agent-reweighted); classical technical documentation 10.6%, API reference 1.3%, troubleshooting 0.4%. P(edit code | read doc)=0.002; within 3 events: create doc lift 1.67 (adj. OR 1.41 [0.98, 2.02]), edit code lift 1.05 (adj. OR 1.33 [1.09, 1.62]), run test lift 0.23 (adj. OR 0.39), build 0.15 (adj. OR 0.25). Triggers: self-initiated 70.2%, user 20.4%, failure-driven 7.5%. Docs first recovery action in 5.4% of 2,034 failure episodes. Production 0.87x consultation. 41.5% of PRs change documentation; code first 4.7x more often than docs (82.5% of orderable cases). AGENTS.md (692 PRs), CLAUDE.md (362), copilot-instructions.md (287) among most-changed files. Merge rates 81.1% vs 75.0%, not distinguishable under clustering

N/A for configurations. Authoring associations unresolved (unadjusted vs adjusted disagree); only reduced testing/building robust. Limitations stated: path-based identification misses docstrings; purpose not measured; Tier-2 labels unvalidated; sticky stage heuristic; regex outcome detection (662 of 2,034 episodes with observable outcome); first-order transitions; fixed lookback; extraction defects for shell-centric agents; opt-in and early-adopter samples; snapshot of fast-moving practice; no multiple-comparison correction

Threats as above (construct, internal, external, conclusion validity). Future: dual human coding of 200-300 events with kappa/alpha; larger sample for recovery-strategy ranking; intervention studies on executable documentation; maintenance cost and staleness of agent working notes not measured

Inconsistencies: SWE-chat release given as 5,850 sessions (p. 3) and 5,851 (pp. 9, 12); single agent family 87% of corpus (p. 11) vs Claude Code 83.8% of labelled sessions (Table 8). Table 9 (per-agent rates) and Table 10 jumbled; per-agent values from text (Claude Code 62.6%, 238/380; Codex 37.2%, 16/43). Replication package (extractors, path rules, Tier-2 labels, event table, scripts) described but no URL given in the PDF. Datasets public (SWE-chat snapshot 19 Aug 2026, ODC-BY; AIDev curated subset).
